tests.name: EventAdvancedTab - require reschedule reason saves the mandatory_for_both option as MANDATORY_BOTH when the event type is submitted
EventAdvancedTab - require reschedule reason saves the mandatory_for_host_only option as MANDATORY_HOST_ONLY when the event type is submitted
EventAdvancedTab - require reschedule reason saves the mandatory_for_attendee_only option as MANDATORY_ATTENDEE_ONLY when the event type is submitted
EventAdvancedTab - minimum cancellation notice hides the setting while the feature flag is off
EventAdvancedTab - minimum cancellation notice places the setting directly after Disable rescheduling, below Disable Cancelling
EventAdvancedTab - minimum cancellation notice shows the saved notice when the event type is reopened
EventAdvancedTab - minimum cancellation notice saves the notice the host sets, in minutes
EventAdvancedTab - minimum cancellation notice saves no notice when the host switches the setting off
EventAdvancedTab - minimum cancellation notice clears the saved notice when Disable Cancelling is turned on
EventAdvancedTab - offer a waitlist is on by default for event types saved before the setting existed
EventAdvancedTab - offer a waitlist sits between the Offer seats and Hide organizer email settings
EventAdvancedTab - offer a waitlist shows the waitlist as off when the event type is reopened after turning it off
EventAdvancedTab - offer a waitlist saves disableWaitlist in the metadata when turned off, keeping the other metadata
EventAdvancedTab - offer a waitlist saves the waitlist as on again when turned back on
EventAdvancedTab - offer a waitlist sends nothing about the waitlist when the host saves without touching it
EventAdvancedTab - offer a waitlist is hidden in platform builds, which have no waitlist
WaitlistService rejects joining a day that ends within 6 hours
WaitlistService rejects a specific time less than 6 hours away or outside the selected day
WaitlistService offers a slot to a specific-time entry only for that exact time
WaitlistService only reports booked times more than 6 hours away
WaitlistService does not create duplicate entries for the same person and day
WaitlistService offers a freed slot to the longest-waiting person and holds it for 6 hours
WaitlistService does not offer slots starting less than 6 hours from now
WaitlistService does not offer a slot that was already rebooked
WaitlistService rolls back a failed offer so the retry goes to the same person, not the next one
WaitlistService never offers the same slot to two people when offers run concurrently
WaitlistService ignores an expiry task left over from a rolled-back offer
WaitlistService passes an expired, unclaimed offer to the next person
WaitlistService marks the offer claimed when the waitlister booked it
WaitlistService leaving with a live offer releases the hold and offers it to the next person
WaitlistService builds a claim URL with the held slot preselected only while the offer is live
WaitlistService offers a slot starting exactly 6 hours from now, since only closer slots are excluded
WaitlistService does not offer a slot of an event type that no longer exists
WaitlistService reports no booked times for an unknown event type instead of failing
WaitlistService expires an offer whose event type was deleted during the hold, without offering it again
WaitlistService seated events reports only times with every seat booked
WaitlistService seated events rejects joining a specific time that still has seats, and accepts it once full
WaitlistService seated events judges a time full by the bookings at that time, not at other times
WaitlistService seated events rejects joining a seated time that has no bookings yet
WaitlistService seated events offers nothing when the freed time is full, even if other times have open seats
WaitlistService seated events offers every seat when the whole seated booking was cancelled
WaitlistService seated events offers a freed seat while other attendees stay booked, holding exactly one seat
WaitlistService seated events offers every open seat, oldest waiter first
WaitlistService seated events counts live offers against capacity, and claimed offers only as bookings
WaitlistService seated events does not offer when no seat is open
WaitlistService seated events marks an expired offer claimed when the waitlister booked a seat
WaitlistService seated events returns an expired offer to waiting when someone else filled the seat
WaitlistService seated events passes an expired seat on to the next person when it is still open
WaitlistService seated events releases the claimant's hold only after they book the offered time of the offered event
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off rejects joining with Forbidden and adds no entry, and accepts joining once turned back on
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off reports no booked times, so the booking page shows no waitlist options, until turned back on
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off makes no offer, hold or email for a freed slot, and keeps everyone waiting in the queue
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off keeps an offer made before it was turned off claimable, with its hold
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off does not pass an expired offer on to the next person
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off still lets people leave, without offering a released spot to the next person
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off offers the next freed slot to people who stayed waiting once turned back on
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off on a seated event reports no full times until turned back on
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off on a seated event rejects joining a full time with Forbidden
WaitlistService when the host turns the waitlist off on a seated event offers no seat freed by one attendee cancelling while others stay booked
WaitlistRepository finds the offers made for one time of one event type, with what's needed to tell if they are live
WaitlistRepository counts attendees of the event type's active bookings in the range, oldest first
WaitlistRepository loads the event type's seat count
WaitlistRepository creates a hold as a single seat when asked to
WaitlistRepository whether the host turned the waitlist off reads turned off metadata as disableWaitlist { disableWaitlist: true }
WaitlistRepository whether the host turned the waitlist off reads turned back on metadata as disableWaitlist { disableWaitlist: false }
WaitlistRepository whether the host turned the waitlist off reads never set, as on every existing event type metadata as disableWaitlist { bookingReminderMinutes: 60 }
WaitlistRepository whether the host turned the waitlist off reads empty metadata metadata as disableWaitlist null
WaitlistRepository whether the host turned the waitlist off returns null for an unknown event type
